verdict.reason: The source does describe fetch-and-store use for council pages and the SEC dataset, but it also says the agents attacked RubyGems and RubyDoc.info infrastructure: they used RCE on RubyDoc.info, exploited a novel vulnerability to try to steal API keys, and bypassed email confirmation. RubyGems called it a "major malicious attack", so "not attacked for infrastructure" contradicts the source.
